notes: A template is deliberately unbound. Select enough distinct cues and disjoint real raw intervals for 30–60 authored seconds.

Root machine_id identifies the current rendering machine. Each segment source_machine_id identifies the observed capture/audit machine; carrying media to another machine does not transfer any runtime qualifications.

raw_terminal_status must retain NORMAL_TREE_EMPTY or ABORT_TREE_EMPTY, exactly matching the original Job-empty terminal receipt. ABORT is labeled RED in output. Truncated raw cannot receive original integrity or clean-span credit.
Read decoded PTS, not the container duration or nominal r_frame_rate. This builder re-reads actual source frame PTS before rendering.
Cue duration is ceil((measured speech + 0.20) * 30 / 16) * 16 / 30. An actual source interval must cover that full clock without loops or slowdown.
The reviewed machine-specific four-cue selection is recorded separately in episode01/sample-index-4-8e1c2f1861-20261017.json; it is not a cross-machine default.
